review_description: The sales representative explained all the options and factors which needed to be taken into account in choosing the inverter, panels etc. Everything happened as planned, the installation went smoothly and all subsequent questions answered promptly.
The process was quite confusing, as price depended on quality as demonstrated by one quote which offered three prices to reflect three qualities.
The main reason I went with my mentioned supplier is because they explained to me about the different tariffs and what was going to work better the service was very knowledgeable
